root_cause.text: The replace_nexthop_single() function in nexthop.c only calls nh_group_v4_update when the old nexthop is IPv4 and the new is IPv6, but fails to update the has_v4 flag when the replacement is from IPv6 to IPv4, leaving groups with a stale has_v4=false that allows IPv6 routes to reference groups containing only IPv4 nexthops, leading to a NULL pointer dereference in nexthop_fib6_nh().
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states: "This is because nh_group_v4_update is only called when replacing AF_INET to AF_INET6, but the reverse direction (AF_INET6 to AF_INET) is missed." The patch diff changes the condition from `if (oldi->family == AF_INET && newi->family == AF_INET6)` to `if (oldi->family != newi->family)` to cover both directions.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix missing update of IPv4 indication when replacing an IPv6 nexthop with an IPv4 nexthop by relaxing the family comparison to any mismatch.
intent_record.what: Changed the comment from 'When replacing an IPv4 nexthop with an IPv6 nexthop, potentially update IPv4 indication' to 'When replacing a nexthop with one of a different family, potentially update IPv4 indication', and changed the condition from 'oldi->family == AF_INET && newi->family == AF_INET6' to 'oldi->family != newi->family'.
intent_record.how: The code now updates the IPv4 indication in all groups using the nexthop whenever the old and new nexthops have different address families, instead of only when replacing an IPv4 nexthop with an IPv6 nexthop. This covers both directions (IPv4→IPv6 and IPv6→IPv4).
